decision_impact.detail: Per-crop yield confidence scales expected yield in the optimiser: most affected green gram 0.507 → 0.303 (-40.2%; rainfall dependency 98% rainfed); least affected maize 0.528 → 0.361 (-31.6%; rainfall dependency 15% rainfed).

decision_impact.title: Priorities changed how TOPSIS picks from the Pareto front
decision_impact.detail: The dominant TOPSIS weight moved from expected yield (0.30) to irrigation water (0.40). NSGA-II itself has no weights; they decide which Pareto plan is recommended.

decision_impact.title: maize lost land
decision_impact.detail: the optimiser moved maize from 35.2% to 0.8% of the land on average over 5 runs (-34.4 pp, p = 0.023). Under the scenario its confidence -31.6%/ha.

decision_impact.title: Some shifts are within search variation
decision_impact.detail: ragi +40.6 pp (p = 0.09), green gram -7.7 pp (p = 0.27). These moves are not consistent across the seed runs, so the optimiser's own randomness could explain them; they are not attributed to the scenario.

sentences: Scenario for Salem Rabi: rainfall -20%; water availability Low; optimisation priorities custom (0.30 / 0.20 / 0.40 / 0.10).
The recommended plan moved from ragi 82%, green gram 18% to groundnut 14%, ragi 53%, red gram 4%, green gram 29%; across 5 runs the shift is consistent for maize.
Irrigation water -30.2%, environmental impact -25.4%, indicative profit -270.4% (mean of 5 runs).
Within the optimiser's run-to-run variation (not attributed to the scenario): expected yield, production cost.
Harder under the scenario: water / irrigation.
Alignment with the district's observed cropping pattern: 9.3% → 25.3%.
summary.text: Scenario for Salem Rabi: rainfall -20%; water availability Low; optimisation priorities custom (0.30 / 0.20 / 0.40 / 0.10). The recommended plan moved from ragi 82%, green gram 18% to groundnut 14%, ragi 53%, red gram 4%, green gram 29%; across 5 runs the shift is consistent for maize. Irrigation water -30.2%, environmental impact -25.4%, indicative profit -270.4% (mean of 5 runs). Within the optimiser's run-to-run variation (not attributed to the scenario): expected yield, production cost. Recommendation confidence 60.7% → 60.9%. Harder under the scenario: water / irrigation. Alignment with the district's observed cropping pattern: 9.3% → 25.3%.
